FN-NRCYQ88-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 107
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Vivian Davis Figures
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 107 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Board of Funeral Services,
ranging from a minimum of $857,000 annually up to a maximum of $2.0 million annually, if
the Board elects to add or increase any of the following board fees proposed by this bill.
Existing Fees Existing Fee Proposed Fee
Amount Amount
Final Disposition Administrative Fee $30 max
Certificate of Authority Application Fee - Initial $198 max $500 max
Certificate of Authority Application Fee- $99 max $500 max
Renewal
Branch Registrant Fee - Initial $198 max $500 max
Branch Registrant Fee - Renewal $500 max
Certificate of Authority Fee- Transfer $132 max $1,000 max
Preneed Sales Agent Fee - Initial $33 max $200 max
Preneed Sales Agent Fee - Renewal $33 max $200 max
Per the board, any fee increases adopted by the board would be used to offset the $300,000
annual transfer from the Department of Insurance set to sunset in FY 2027.
Page 1

FN-NRCYQ88-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 107
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Sponsor: Senator Vivian Davis Figures
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/16/2026
Senate Bill 107 as passed the Senate would increase receipts to the Alabama Board of Funeral
Services Fund by an estimated-minimum of $857,000 annually to an estimated-maximum of
$2.0 million annually, if the Board elects to add or increase any of the following fees, as
provided by this bill. The existing fee amounts shown are currently set by rule at the maximum
amount currently provided by law:
Fees Existing Fee Proposed Fee Cap
Amount
Final Disposition Administrative Fee new $30 max
Certificate of Authority Application Fee - Initial $198 $500 max
Certificate of Authority Application Fee - Annual $99 $500 max
Renewal
Branch Registrant Fee - Initial $198 $500 max
Branch Registrant Fee - Annual Renewal new $500 max
Certificate of Authority Fee - Transfer $132 $500 max
Preneed Sales Agent Fee - Initial $33 $200 max
Preneed Sales Agent Fee - Annual Renewal $33 $200 max
Per the board, any fee increases adopted by the board would be used to offset the $300,000
annual transfer from the Department of Insurance set to sunset, under current law, in FY 2027.
Page 1
